interface.signature: say_hello(name: List[str], city: str, state: str) -> str

preconditions.description: The name array must contain at least one value.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, str) for n in name)
preconditions.description: All elements in the name array must be strings.
The city must be a string.
The state must be a string.

postconditions.description: The returned string must start with 'Hello, '.
The returned string must end with '! Welcome to {city}, {state}!' where {city} and {state} are the provided city and state.
The returned string must be constructed by joining the name array with spaces and appending the city and state in the specified format.
